summary: Router decisions + Subagents feeds now collapsed by default behind an 'Activity ▸/▾' toggle in graph.html. Wrapped .small as #activity; added .acttoggle header (#activityToggle with #actArrow) + #activity.collapsed CSS; applyActivity() toggles class + arrow, state persisted in localStorage('orchActivity'), default collapsed. tick() still fills #routes/#agents so they're current when expanded. Independent tray + graph stay visible. Verified node --check SYNTAX OK + served page has toggle/handler/CSS. Hard-reload to see the clean view.
